India narrowly defeats Japan in rain-shortened T20 cricket match

India secured a narrow two-run victory over Japan in a rain-affected one-off T20 international cricket match. The game was reduced to five overs per side due to inclement weather. India scored 32 runs for the loss of 4 wickets in their allotted overs, narrowly avoiding an upset against the Japanese team.
